title: Pseudo-Anosov flows, hyperbolic geometry, and the curve graph
summary: Starting with a pseudo-Anosov flow $\varphi$ on a closed hyperbolic $3$-manifold $M$ and an embedded surface $S \subset M$ that is (almost) transverse to $\varphi$, we relate the hyperbolic geometry of $M$ (e.g. volume, circumference, short geodesics) to dynamical invariants of $\varphi$ encoded by the curve graph of $S$.
